title.narrative: GLA II - IUCN NL - Bolivia

description.narrative: The GLA programme in Bolivia seeks to influence the policies and practices of public, private and civil actors that contribute to the inclusive and sustainable management of forest landscapes, through the development of capacities for lobby and advocacy at different scales. The GLA Alliance believes that the Greater Chiquitanía can maintain its valuable ecosystems and provide the people with income, health and well-being. The GLA Alliance has built and supported a network of organisations that are now actively involved in issues related to landscape governance. The programme has mainly focused on three intervention pathways: 1) Innovation for sustainable forest management, 2) Integral management of natural ecosystems, and 3) Efficient implementation of local environmental regulations.

description.narrative: This result shows # of times that CSOs succeed in creating space for CSO demands and positions through agenda setting, influencing the debate and/or creating space to engage, as result of GLA efforts

title.narrative: # of advocacy initiatives carried out by CSOs, for, by or with their membership/constituency

description.narrative: Measures the advocacy initiatives carried out by CSOs, for, by or with their membership/constituency at national and international level

comment.narrative: At the beginning of the GLA2 programme no spaces were created to engage at national and international level as a result of for CSO engagement in the programme

CSOs succeeded in creating space for CSO demands and positions through agenda setting, influencing the debate and-or creating space to engage at national and international level 24 times. For example two partners have systematised and documented on violence against environmental human rights defenders which received a lot of international coverage.

The aim of the programme is to increase the level of influence or participation in decision making by CSOs and IPLCs in more processes. In addition, the programme aims to increase the level of participation by women and young women/men in all processes. No specific target is defined in this case.

The aim of the programme is to increase the level of influence or participation in decision making by CSOs and IPLCs in more processes. In addition, the programme aims to increase the level of participation by women and young women/men in all processes. No specific target is defined in this case.

title.narrative: # of governmental policies for sustainable and inclusive development that are better implemented as a result of CSO engagement

description.narrative: Measures the number of governmental policies that are better implemented as a result of GLA efforts

comment.narrative: At the beginning of the GLA2 programme no governmental policies have been better implemented for sustainable and inclusive development as a result of CSO engagement

2 governmental policies have been better implemented for sustainable and inclusive development as a result of CSO engagement at midline. For example four environmental defenders were prosecuted in the case of a community of settlers in a Departemental Reserve in Robore. They continued their work in defence of protected areas in Robore, despite the threats and lawsuits against them, receiving broad support from the population until finally, the Public Prosecutor Office rejected the complaint and the police actions.

The target of the GLA2 programme is to better implement 1 government policies for sustainable and inclusive development as a result of CSO engagement, specifically focusing on extractive industries, agricultural frontier and collective rights.
